headline: Google deploys URL redirects as AI search integration accelerates
body: Google is implementing goto URL redirects to search results links, marking another step in its AI-augmented search strategy. The move reflects how search engines are restructuring user pathways as generative AI features become standard. For healthcare AI implementation, this signals how major platforms are reshaping information discovery workflows. Clinicians and health systems should monitor how search behavior changes affect clinical decision support tool adoption and EHR integration strategies. Organizations building on Google's health AI infrastructure need to account for evolving user routing patterns in their implementation roadmaps.
